newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAPIOLA SEES 15 PCT GROWTH IN 96 INVESTMENT INCOME.
newsitem.headline: TAPIOLA SEES 15 PCT GROWTH IN 96 INVESTMENT INCOME.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Tapiola-Yhtiot said on Thursday that it expects the group's 1996 investment income to grow almost by 15 percent to 1.79 billion markka from 1.56 billion in 1995.

"The group's investment income will continue to grow. The growth in net investment income is projected at almost 15 percent excluding appreciation," finance director Juhani Heiskanen told a news conference.
He said the group's solvency capital has surged 224 percent in 1996 after a 186 percent increase in 1995. At end-August this year, Tapiola's solvency capital was 3.36 billion markka.
Tapiola said the market value of its investments has increased by almost four billion markka to 29.3 billion in 1996.
